remarks: Darling In-town home! Fresh interior paint, updated kitchen and baths with tons of storage and sunny back yard. First floor offers porch foyer, living room/family room, dining room, kitchen with loads of cabinetry, back door mud area and half bath. Upstairs to the second floor there is a full bath, two ample bedrooms, one with a walk-in closet and a smaller bedroom/office. The home is complete with a walk-up attic and full basement for all your storage needs. Just seconds to shopping & restaurants.
